description: Motion profiles and drive electronics example. A DC motor follows a jerk-limited S-curve of one revolution (0 -> 2 pi rad from 0.1 s, v_max 20 rad/s, a_max 200 rad/s^2, j_max 4000 rad/s^3, end at 0.564 s) under a 1 ms discrete PD on a 4096-count encoder, commanding the duty of an averaged H-bridge on a 24 V bus.

checks.note: the S-curve ends exactly at q_end = 2 pi
the cruise at v_max from 0.25 s to 0.414 s
the move is long enough to reach a_max
tracking error during the move (measured 0.0176 rad at 0.448 s, no velocity feedforward)
after the move the loop holds the target within a few encoder counts (1 count = 1.53 mrad; measured 1.53 mrad)
the true shaft angle at the end (measured 6.28367 rad)
winding current (measured peak 1.41 A); the duty stays far inside -1..1
no solver failure, no connection or causality error and no event-limit stop
